verdict.reasoning: Garvit's native strength is relatable, cost-saving utility hacks delivered in rapid Hinglish that appeal deeply to Indian creators and students (evidenced by his Type C scripts averaging 435 likes). However, competitors achieve massive scale and agency authority by framing tools around business systems and multi-step workflows. Blending Garvit's accessible, money-saving punchiness with competitors' structured frameworks (e.g. multi-step agents, workflows) will elevate retention and comment conversions.
